map.为什么在不同键盘上结果不一样？: Why do the results differ across keyboards?
map.因为 keyCode 反映的是按键产生的字符码，会受布局、输入法与修饰键影响；c: Because keyCode reflects the character code a key press produces, which is affected by layout, input method and modifiers, whereas code reflects the physical key position (KeyQ is always the Q position). Use code for games or global shortcuts, and key for judging text input. Also note that the semantics of meta and ctrl on Mac differ from Windows.

map.不同键盘布局/输入法下 key 值可能变化；code 反映物理位置更稳定。: The key value can change with keyboard layout or input method; code reflects the physical position and is more stable.
